title: The release dossier is a pure function over the ledger, re-measured at a sha
description:
SPIDR child 1 of task-2a345b2e97d94599b4688af1923056e5 (architect-20a6d1eb, 2026-09-05). Dependency-free LEAF and the intellectual core of Gate 3: everything else in the parent is plumbing around this function.

WHAT THIS ROW OWNS: a PURE generator that turns the ledger reads into deterministic dossier markdown for a goal AT A GIVEN SHA, plus its durable bytes. No command kind, no PR, no UI - those are siblings.

MEASURED AT HEAD (branch moe/work-2026-09-04) by architect-20a6d1eb, gap is REAL: `grep -rn 'release\.decide|RELEASE_DOSSIER|release-dossier' --include=*.ts apps/ packages/` returns ZERO (the one hit for `moe-release-handoff-binding/1` at apps/daemon/src/work/release-handoff-binding.ts:55 is the WORK handoff, unrelated - do not extend it). `packages/release` and `scripts/release` are moe-next's OWN release tooling, not the product's; do not reuse them.

THE INPUTS ALL EXIST: `/runs/read` (apps/daemon/src/http/runs-read.ts) already carries per-node review rounds, verifier receipts, landing and publish; `POST /documents/coverage/read` (http/document-coverage-read.ts) carries per-criterion coverage - but it is keyed on the PRD contentSha256, NOT the shipping git sha, which is exactly the mismatch this row exists to close.

RE-MEASUREMENT IS THE POINT, not a detail. The dossier is built at the workspace HEAD sha, and every cited landing commit must be proven an ANCESTOR of that sha. A commit that is not an ancestor renders UNKNOWN and is LISTED - never silently dropped, because a dossier that omits what it could not verify reads as complete evidence while being incomplete. `dossier(shaA)` and `dossier(shaB)` must differ on the sha column; a generator that ignores its sha argument would pass every single-sha test.

SECTIONS: per approved criterion -> verifying node -> verifier receipt (command, exit, sha) -> landing commit sha; review rounds and refusals; the preview decision when one exists, or the explicit sentence that there is none; the installed policy revision.
definitionOfDone: A pure generator produces deterministic markdown for (goal, sha) from injected ledger reads - no store handle of its own, no clock, no git shelling inside the pure core. A golden test pins every section: the criteria table (criterion -> node -> receipt command/exit/sha -> landing sha), review rounds and refusals, the preview decision or its explicit absence, and the installed policy revision.

RE-MEASUREMENT PROVEN, both directions: a landing sha that is NOT an ancestor of the given sha renders UNKNOWN and appears in a listed section (assert the criterion id appears in the output - a dropped row is the failure being guarded); and `dossier(shaA)` differs from `dossier(shaB)` on the sha column for the same goal. The second arm is what catches a generator that ignores its sha argument.

DETERMINISM: the same inputs produce byte-identical output across two calls, and the ordering of every list is explicit (sorted by a named key), so a Map iteration order change cannot silently reorder a released dossier. Assert byte equality, not section presence.

The dossier bytes are stored durably under a versioned record (e.g. `moe-release-dossier/1`, mirroring the shape of repository/landing-receipt-contracts.ts) keyed so the PR body can be re-derived and DIFFED later; a test reads the bytes back and re-derives an identical dossier.

The absent-evidence path is explicit, not empty: a goal with no preview decision states so in words; a criterion with no verifying node is listed as uncovered rather than omitted. A test asserts the words for both.
Gates quoted with their `Test Files N passed` count lines: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm typecheck`.
taskRails: PURE CORE. The generator takes injected reads and returns bytes; ancestry checks and store access live at the edges. A pure core is what makes the golden test meaningful and the re-derivation possible.

NEVER DROP UNMEASURABLE EVIDENCE. UNKNOWN is a rendered value, not an omission. A dossier that silently omits what it could not verify is worse than one that says so, because the reader cannot tell the difference between absent and unverified.
DO NOT reuse packages/release or scripts/release - those release moe-next itself, not the product being built. Do not extend moe-release-handoff-binding/1, which is the work-handoff record.
FEATURES ONLY (inherited): no security-boundary or policy work; signing and hermetic verification stay out of scope.
